craft_notes: Sthāyin: barren-yet-appearing. Rows: both said. Rejected: senses-path invention — killed: not in L3. Read aloud: held paradox.

lines: Here too by the real road emission is sequence-barren — said;
sequence-appearing is too, and so said.
l4.sanskrit_cite: atra caiṣāṃ vāstavena pathā kramavandhyaiva sṛṣṭir ity uktaṃ kramāvabhāso 'pi cāstīty api uktam eva
